title: Platforms Overview
meta_description: Eight proprietary platforms encode our delivery patterns as configurable products — governance, security controls and evidence generation arrive pre-built.

blocks.x: Eight proprietary platforms encode a decade of deep-tech delivery as configurable products: decision intelligence, lakehouse, agent orchestration, security fabric, digital twin operations, advanced compute, digital trust and AI governance.

Each platform packages a proprietary method family as a product you can run: Nexus decides in milliseconds with a replayable trail, Forge keeps the lakehouse contracted and affordable, Swarm runs agent fleets inside policy envelopes, Sentinel encrypts collaboration, Twinverse mirrors physical operations, Quanta benchmarks every optimization run against the best classical solver, Ledger makes records auditable, and Compass governs the whole decision estate.
Start from the platform that matches the metric you are accountable for, or bring the use case to a briefing and we will show the same scenario running on your data rather than on a demo script.
Start with the diagnostic, not the contract: the section map above baselined in two weeks, and a scoped proposal only if the delta justifies it.
